# Termux-STT Full Technical Specification (v1.0.0)
Official Documentation & Deep Architecture Reference for Autonomous AI Agents.

## 1. System Overview
Unified On-Device Speech-to-Text & Pure-Python 128d Speaker Diarization Framework
Unifies Whisper.cpp, Vosk, and Sherpa-ONNX with a closed-form pure-Python 128d speaker diarization algorithm running 100% on-device.

## 2. Package & Installation
- PyPI: termux-stt
- Command: pip install termux-stt
# or:
npm install termux-stt
- Repository: https://github.com/uno-km/termux-stt

## 3. Core Capabilities
- **Deterministic 0-Drift Output**: Bit-exact floating-point precision verified across heterogeneous ARM64 & WebGPU hardware.
- **Zero Cloud Egress Architecture**: Operates 100% on the local client without external network telemetry leaks.
- **Memory Leakage Protection**: Weakref lifetime management preventing GPU VRAM / system RAM leaks.

## 4. Canonical Implementation
```python
import termux_stt as stt

transcriber = stt.UnifiedSTT(engine="whisper", model="tiny.ko")
result = transcriber.transcribe("meeting_recording.wav", diarization=True)
for segment in result.segments:
    print(f"[{segment.speaker}] {segment.start:.2f}s: {segment.text}")
```
